purpose: R244 non-financial HS300 gross profitability versus a matched quality-cash control

universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

factor.formula: (TTM revenue - TTM operating_costs) / total_assets_t; higher means greater gross-profit productivity per unit of assets
factor.effective_date: current report statutory disclosure deadline + 3 calendar days

samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four components proportionally
execution.stitching: two segment returns compounded into one curve; first day of each later segment skipped

caveats: The clean point-in-time financial sample starts in 2022; 2018-2020 financials are excluded because reliable first-disclosure dates are unavailable.
The factor uses statutory disclosure deadlines as a fallback for first disclosure time.
Local financial tables are current snapshots, so restatement risk remains.
Operating-cost classifications can differ across firms and industries, affecting cross-sectional comparability.
The industry snapshot used to exclude financials is current rather than historical PIT.
The full curve is stitched from two system-engine segments; segment boundaries can reset an open position.
Trade P&L shares are contribution diagnostics from two segments each starting at 1,000,000 notional, not a compounded-return decomposition.
The factor is research-only until every preregistered gate passes; passing would justify paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
